business: Confirmation records an attributed local candidate intention for the exact inspected package and its current request. It never creates semantic admission, publisher authentication, current permission or an actual owner outcome. Public command files cannot provide their own observation.
bridge: Reuse the existing protected ConfirmObservedPackage operation and shared Session transition. Its native pipeline stage receives the exact original manifest/request bindings plus the schema-decoded observed request. Native scope, actor, revision, eligibility and request equality checks remain mandatory. JSON text carriers are normalized through the existing native wire mappings at the public command boundary.
system: Persist the complete observation with its command in a hash-chained v2 journal event. Replay uses the recorded observation and the same pinned authored pipeline. Both command and observation must match on idempotent replay. Read and validate real package bytes before entering the journal lock; no fabricated permission or owner handles. The checked private entry retains its declared access contract; local pure CLI evaluation does not claim that entry authorization was exercised.
compatibility: Predecessor source epochs remain explicit refusals. Audit existing non-fixture journals before removing predecessor code and preserve or migrate any usable user records through an explicit source-bound process.
